shadows.name: glow-primary
shadows.purpose: Interactive focus for Command Center elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button for the command center.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0ea5e9; color: #050505; border: none; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(14,165,233,0.4); background: #49bcfa; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Premium project container with scanline effect.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141414; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 280px; height: 160px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-card-scanner { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: #0ea5e9; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #0ea5e9; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-scanner { animation: scan 2s linear infinite; opacity: 0.6; } @keyframes scan { 0% { top: 0; } 100% { top: 100%; } } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 8px; color: #0ea5e9; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; color: #f5f5f7; letter-spacing: 1px; }

narrative.overview: A high-density technical workspace replicating the precision of professional NLE software. Built on deep blacks and functional signal colors.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent colors must denote functional meaning or software alignment, never purely decorative.

rules.name: The Lit-Edge Rule
rules.body: Differentiate surfaces via 1px tinted borders acting as rim lights rather than shadows.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for system output
Do utilize Bebas Neue for large-scale impact
Do use tinted greys for backgrounds
donts: Don't use standard rounded buttons or bubbly UI
Don't create a normal website walkthrough feel
